The equation is  
\[
5v+4h+3t=12.
\]
Nonnegative integer solutions are:
\[
(v,h,t)=(0,0,4),(0,3,0),(1,1,1).
\]
Check the throw-count bounds:
- \(t \le 6v+5h\): \((0,0,4)\) fails since \(4>0\).
- \(h \le 6v+1+4t\): \((0,3,0)\) fails since \(3>1\).
- \((1,1,1)\) satisfies all bounds.

Thus, each person was hit exactly once.

\[
\boxed{\text{Vifsla: }1,\ \text{Tofsla: }1,\ \text{Hemul: }1}
\]
